status: appended after the S29 calibration refusal and before any S30 selection run; v1, the T2 verdict and their receipts are unchanged
why: The S29 calibration pass refused to emit a suite version because every arm's answer was constant. The S30 forensics (results/capability/forensics-20261116T170100Z.json) and sanity ladder (results/capability/ladder/D-20261116T170500Z.json) measured the cause: the completion arm repeats the example letter that the answer-format instruction shows ('C' for patch-selection, 'B' for diagnostic-identification), and with no example letter it applies a fixed position prior. Its choice does not follow the candidate content under permutation. A format that requires free-form generation therefore cannot discriminate on these arms, by construction. This registration replaces generation in the selection formats with a likelihood ranking and registers the entropy screen that excludes a format whose answers are still constant.

instrument.name: likelihood-selection
instrument.score: the model's own log-probability of a candidate's content as a continuation of the selection prompt; no sampling, no greedy decoding and no free-form generation
instrument.sum_statement: the exact sum of the candidate's token log-probabilities
instrument.mean_statement: the exact sum divided by the candidate's token count (length-normalised); the registered primary, because a sum rewards a long candidate structurally
instrument.diagnostic_mode_statement: the letter modes score ' A'/' B'/' C' given the prompt; they are recorded as an unscored diagnostic of position bias and never decide an item

not_formats.body-completion: still a free-form format; it is screened, and excluded for an arm whose answers are constant, rather than scored
not_formats.file-replacement: still a free-form format; same rule

primary.endpoint: the candidate the ranking chose passes the executable checker (for a diagnostic item, its option's registered consequence compiles and resolves the failure, reported on verified_diagnostic)
primary.margin_statement: the ranking margin (best minus runner-up log-probability) is recorded per item and never substituted for the executable outcome; a correctly ranked item can still fail to compile
primary.decision_rule: unchanged from v4 and v1: 10% relative improvement, paired 95% CI lower bound above zero, no category regressing by more than 0.05 absolute

secondary.role: descriptive only, recorded per item, never a decision input

diagnostic.role: reported separately with its own item count; never pooled with executable success
diagnostic.rule: an option is verified by applying that option's registered consequence and compiling it

anti_gaming.labels_not_scored: the candidate's positional label is not part of the scored content
anti_gaming.reference_flags_not_scored: the reference flag is read for the audit and never passed to the scorer
anti_gaming.checker_not_visible: selection runs in the oracle court with no cargo and no checker; the check stage runs after, in the rust court
anti_gaming.position_is_not_an_input: the ranking is over content scores, so the display position cannot favour a candidate; the per-item reference position is recorded and its histogram summarised (position_audit) to show the reference is not always shown in the same place
anti_gaming.no_truncation: a scored sequence longer than 4096 tokens refuses rather than scoring a prefix

entropy_screen.rule: for every format, the arm's answers across items are counted by their comparable key (the chosen letter for a selection format, the whitespace-normalised text for a free-form format). Below the entropy minimum or above the modal-share maximum, the format is marked non-discriminating and excluded for that arm; it is not scored
entropy_screen.why: a constant answer has entropy zero and cannot separate items or arms; excluding it prevents the base rate of the constant from being reported as accuracy

pilot.rationale: the two cheapest arms; the pilot measures the instrument, not a capability comparison
pilot.items: every patch-selection and diagnostic-identification item of the calibration split (37)
must_establish: per-format accuracy for each arm from the executable checker
the across-arm spread per format, and whether any format is non-zero and non-saturated
the entropy screen's verdict per format and arm, with an excluded format excluded rather than scored
the measured baseline and paired variance, and the required n for 80% power at a 10% relative effect, or an explicit statement that this n is unreachable
must_not: change the T2 verdict or the v1 calibration window
report the five-arm comparison: the instrument is not yet calibrated and not yet powered

power.baseline: the measured mean per-item pass rate over the likelihood-selected selection items, not an assumed 0.5
power.variance: the variance of per-item paired differences over the arm pairs the pilot actually ran
power.cannot_be_finalised_now: no likelihood-selection run has happened, so neither the baseline nor Var(d) exists; the pilot reports both and the required n, or names it as unreachable

does_not_change.v1_calibration_window: the S28 window, its thresholds and results/capability/calibration-20261116T164100Z.json are unchanged
does_not_change.t2_verdict: The registered T2 verdict (error_direction_not_supported), its thresholds, its KL/PC endpoint and its receipts are unchanged.
